name: Ananya Mehta
quote: The most exquisite eggless wedding cake we could have dreamed of. Guests could not believe it was eggless — pure magic.

name: Rohan Kapoor
quote: Our clients still talk about the festive hampers. Impeccable packaging and flavour that feels genuinely premium.

name: Sara D’Souza
quote: Every birthday now comes from GHARELU.BAKE. It truly tastes home-made in the best possible way. Warm and beautiful.

name: Imran Shaikh
quote: The Belgian truffle is the best chocolate cake I've had in the city — eggless or otherwise. Ridiculously good.

name: Priya Nair
quote: Ordered the macaron box for a baby shower and they were flawless. Delicate, fresh and beautifully presented.

name: Vikram Sethi
quote: Salted caramel gateau stole the show. That honeycomb crunch is unreal. Will absolutely order again.

name: Meher Irani
quote: Their sourdough has become a Sunday ritual for us. Crackling crust, tangy crumb — proper artisan bread.

name: Aditya Rao
quote: Seamless bulk ordering and dispatch was right on time. The team loved every box. Highly recommend for gifting.

name: Kavya Menon
quote: The red velvet cupcakes are dangerously good. Moist, tangy cream cheese, and they arrived beautifully boxed.
